title: The Desktop scrollbar when in front of an item, if dragged, will move both the scrollbar and the item underneath it
line: Dragging the desktop scrollbar where it covers an icon now only scrolls the view, without picking up or selecting the icon.
explanation: The desktop's scrollbars were attached inside the area that handles icon presses, so a press on the scrollbar also reached the icon underneath: dragging the scrollbar there dragged that icon along, and a click or double-click could select or open it. The press handler tried to skip scrollbar presses with a viewport check, but that check dates from the old ScrollArea and never matched. The change moves both scrollbars out of that area and on top of it (still attached to the grid), so they only scroll the view, and drops the dead check.

commits.message:
containments/desktop: Don't drag icons when using the scrollbar

Dragging or clicking the desktop scrollbar over an icon also moved or
selected that icon, because the scrollbars sat inside the area handling
icon clicks; they now sit on top of it, so they only scroll the view.

BUG: 518558

media.caption: Before: mid-drag of the scrollbar where it covers f026, the icon is picked up and follows the pointer
After: same drag, the view scrolls and no icon is picked up
Before: after release, f026 has been moved and is selected
After: after release, nothing moved or selected

review.text: Clean architectural fix in FolderView.qml that moves the vertical and horizontal scrollbars out of MouseEventListener and stacks them above it while keeping them attached to GridView, removing the dead scrollArea.viewport.contains() check. Updating containsMouse to also include verticalScrollBar.hovered and horizontalScrollBar.hovered thoughtfully preserves folder popup hover behavior, and anchoring matches standard mirroring and back-button margins without introducing regressions. The before/after evidence clearly proves the fix.

reviews.text: Clean architectural fix in FolderView.qml that moves the vertical and horizontal scrollbars out of MouseEventListener and stacks them above it while keeping them attached to GridView, removing the dead scrollArea.viewport.contains() check. Updating containsMouse to also include verticalScrollBar.hovered and horizontalScrollBar.hovered thoughtfully preserves folder popup hover behavior, and anchoring matches standard mirroring and back-button margins without introducing regressions. The before/after evidence clearly proves the fix.

Right root cause: the scrollbars were children of the GridView inside the MouseEventListener, so presses on them reached the icon handler, and the viewport.contains() guard could never be false because the GridView fills the listener. Moving the scrollbars out of the listener as siblings that still attach to the GridView is a clean QML-level fix in plasma-desktop, and the containsMouse change correctly keeps folder popups from starting their close timer over the scrollbar. The screenshots clearly show the icon being dragged before and plain scrolling after, and the commit and line match the diff.
